caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a dark reddish-brown hue, featuring a semi-circular or drop-leaf design, with one leaf extended downward. The tabletop has a smooth surface with visible wood grain patterns. The table stands on four straight legs, each adorned with vertical decorative elements in lighter tones, possibly gold or yellow, interspersed along the corners and ends of the legs. The apron, or skirt, beneath the tabletop includes oval inlays or painted decorations that match the decorative style on the legs. The background is a plain light beige color, with three small decorative motifs: one oval design centered above the table and two vertical symmetrical designs, one on each side of the oval, all in black and white. The drawing is composed on a flat, featureless surface, focusing attention solely on the table and the small decorative motifs above it.
title: Pembroke Table (Drop Leaf)
